description: This Dart file defines the AppColors class which provides color constants and a method to generate a Material3 ColorScheme for theming purposes in a Flutter application. It serves as a centralized color palette for the Ocean Professional theme.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: A class encapsulating color tokens used across the Ocean Professional theme for consistent UI styling.

methods.name: colorScheme
methods.description: Builds and returns a Material3 ColorScheme object aligned with the Ocean Professional theme palette, considering light or dark mode.
